This document cleans the raw data that are exported from MetaReviewer and organizes it into smaller, more manageable data chunks based on the codebook. This should be run first for any new data export. 

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Loading Packages
```{r load-packages, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse) # for data cleaning and visualizations
```

## Importing Data
```{r data, message=FALSE}
# Coded documents
data_raw <- read.csv("data/raw_data_12_30.csv")

# Meta-analyses
included_ma <- read.csv("data/ma_data.csv")
```

## Global Themes 
```{r theme}
# to set consistent themes
viz_theme <- theme_classic()
```


## Labels for MAs
```{r ma-labels}
# last name, year
ma_labels <- included_ma %>%
  select(ma_id, label)
```

# Review Meta-Analysis Characteristics & Creating Lists

## Meta-Analyses Outcomes
```{r MA-outcomes}
# Math
ma_math <- included_ma %>%
  filter(out_mathematics == "Yes") %>%
  pull(ma_id, label)

ma_math

# Reading
ma_read <- included_ma %>%
  filter(out_reading == "Yes") %>%
  pull(ma_id, label)

ma_read
```

## Meta-Analyses with Use Strategies
```{r MA-strategies}
table(included_ma$visualization)
table(included_ma$es_metrics)
table(included_ma$stake_engagement)

# Meta-Analyses with Visualizations
ma_viz <- included_ma %>%
  filter(visualization == "Yes") %>%
  pull(ma_id, label)

ma_viz

# Meta-Analyses with Effect Transformations
ma_es_trans <- included_ma %>%
  filter(es_metrics == "Yes") %>%
  pull(ma_id, label)

ma_es_trans

# Meta-Analyses with Stakeholders
ma_stake <- included_ma %>%
  filter(stake_engagement == "Yes") %>%
  pull(ma_id,label)

ma_stake

# Meta-Analyses with Implications
ma_imp <- included_ma %>%
  filter(section == "Yes") %>%
  pull(ma_id,label)

ma_imp
```

## Dataset of MAs and Use Strategies as indicators
```{r use-indicators}
ma_use_ind <- included_ma %>%
  select(ma_id, label, out_mathematics, out_reading, visualization, 
         es_metrics, stake_engagement, section)
```


# Cleaning Data

## ID Checks to remove test rows from data
```{r cleaning-test-rows, message=FALSE}
data_working <- data_raw 

table(data_working$ma_id_check) 

data_working[data_working == "M10016\t"] <- "M10016" # one label had extra characters

table(data_working$ma_id_check)
```

## Cleaning data for analysis 
```{r clean-data}
# removing extra MetaReviewer columns
data_clean <- data_working %>%
  select(3, 40:114) # keeping ids and coded data

names(data_clean)[names(data_clean) == "ma_id_check"] <- "ma_id"
data_clean <- merge(data_clean, ma_labels, by = "ma_id", all.x = TRUE)

data_clean <- data_clean %>%
  relocate(last_col(), .after = ma_id) # moving to second column
```

## Unique ID Check
```{r unique_id_check, message=FALSE}
# checking where Study
data_clean <- data_clean %>%
  mutate(u_id_check = ifelse(unique_id_check == study_id, unique_id_check, FALSE))

table(data_clean$u_id_check) 

# only one discrepancy, so I have confirmed the unique_id_check was correct and am moving the column to the front
data_clean <- data_clean %>% 
  mutate(unique_id = ifelse(unique_id_check == study_id, unique_id_check, unique_id_check)) %>%
  relocate(unique_id, .after = label) %>% # moving column to front
  select(-c(study_id, unique_id_check, u_id_check)) # removing extra unique ID columns
```


## Context Check
```{r practice-context}
table(data_clean$context_conf)

data_context_blank <- data_clean %>%
  mutate(context_check = ifelse(context_conf == "", FALSE, TRUE))

table(data_context_blank$context_check)

data_context_blank <- data_context_blank %>%
  filter(context_check == FALSE)

# list of blank IDs
specific_ids <- data_context_blank %>%
  pull(unique_id)

specific_ids

#U11032 I started to code but the document was no longer available and it could not be coded. It will be removed with the non-practice documents. 
```

## looking at location of citation 
```{r location}
data_missing <- data_clean %>% 
  filter(present == "None" | present == "Other" | present == "Other,None")
```


## Looking at documents with no context selected and duplicate rows and No longer available
```{r check-context}
duplicates <- data_clean %>%
  group_by(unique_id) %>%
  filter(n() > 1 | unique_id %in% specific_ids) %>%
  arrange(unique_id)

# removing documents that aren't available or had incorrect citations.

data_clean <- data_clean %>%
  filter(unique_id != "U10608" &
           unique_id != "U10193")

```

## Clean Data set of only practice documents
```{r practice-only}
# Filtering out Methodological and Policy Documents 
practice <- data_clean %>%
  filter(context_conf == "Practice")

# Adding individual document IDs that don't repeat
practice <- practice %>%
  mutate(id = sprintf("D%05d", 10000 + row_number())) %>% # adding id number
  select(id, everything()) # moving to first column
```

## Save Practice Data Set as .csv
```{r save-full-data}
write_csv(practice, "data/s2_data_clean.csv")
```

# Example MAs

These are example meta-analyses highlighting
```{r example-ma-data}

example_ids <- c("M10003", "M10005", "M10016", "M10019")

example <- practice %>%
  filter(ma_id %in% example_ids) %>% 
  select(id:unique_id, stat_info:descrip_explain, es_descrip:variability_explain,
         design:interpretation_explain, name_ma:frame_explain, 
         population:other, valence:valence_explain)

example_data <- merge(example, ma_use_ind, by = "ma_id")

write_csv(example_data, "data/example_data.csv")
```

# Subset MA data
```{r select-ma-data}
ma_results <- included_ma %>%
  select(ma_id, label, out_reading, out_mathematics, studies_n, es_n, 
         hetero_rq, average_es, stake_engagement, table_study, 
         par_grade:mod_set_na, es_metrics, visualization, explicit_ure, 
         text_type_instrumental:text_type_mandated, target_teacher:target_other,
         section) 
```

# Merge Data

## Data related to Effect Size/Results

```{r es-data}
# Select doc data related to es
doc_es <- practice %>%
  select(ma_id, label, unique_id, id, 
         stat_info:descrip_explain, es_descrip:variability_explain)

# Select ma data related to es
ma_es <- ma_results %>%
  select(ma_id, out_reading, out_mathematics, studies_n, es_n, 
         hetero_rq, average_es)
  
# merge
es <- merge(doc_es, ma_es, by = "ma_id")

write.csv(es, "data/es_ma.csv")
```

# Evaluating Discrepencies between s1 and s2

```{r loading-data}
s1 <- read.csv("data/s1_practice.csv")

s1 <- s1 %>% 
  rename("unique_id" = "unique_ID") %>% 
  rename("ma_id" = "ma_ID")

s2 <- read.csv("data/s2_data_clean.csv")

```


```{r discrepencies}
s1_not_in_s2 <- anti_join(s1, s2, by = c("ma_id", "unique_id"))

s1_not_in_s2
```
